title: Milestone 0.4: API freeze for chat crates
description: Freeze the public API of jmap-chat-types, jmap-chat-server (esp. the ChatBackend trait) and jmap-chat-client once the epics that still reshape it land: JMAP-y3f2 (chat core conformance, incl. the channel permission resolver y3f2.1), JMAP-5mz6 (extension seams: Space property hook, cascade callbacks, outbound-event hook, room restrictions dfo4, server-created messages 53vd) and JMAP-yuut (ephemeral delivery rules). After the freeze, federation, MIMI, DID and VTC should land additively through the seams. Status at 2026-10-20 audit: chat-00 135 requirements, 68 implemented / 41 partial / 22 missing. 0.3.0 ships as explicitly pre-stable.
acceptance_criteria: All three dependency epics closed; a review pass confirms ChatBackend needs no further required methods for the planned federation/MIMI/DID/VTC work (seams suffice); CHANGELOG and crate docs declare the 0.4 API stable for the chat crates.
